meta.title: Lilis Pics — Lili Marchetti, photographer
meta.description: Portraits, street and the quiet in-between, by Lili Marchetti — an independent photographer based in Montréal.

hero.intro: You don't need to know how to pose. You only need to be yourself. I'll take care of the rest.

carousel.alt: Portrait photography by Lili, image {n} of {total}

about.body: Hi, I’m Lili, a photographer based in Montreal. Inspired by cinematic storytelling, I create timeless images filled with genuine emotion. My priority is making every session feel relaxed, comfortable and natural, because the best memories are made when you’re simply yourself.

landscape.title: Landscapes
landscape.desc: Open air, big skies, soft horizons — the silence of a long walk.

street.title: Streets
street.desc: People in the middle of their own lives, caught between two steps.

product.title: Still life
product.desc: Small objects, warm tables, the poetry of something well-made.

portrait.title: Portraits
portrait.desc: A face, a mood, a single afternoon. I notice the small things you'd forget.

fashion.title: Editorials
fashion.desc: Quiet, considered stories — usually just me, a person and the light we found that day.

macro.title: Macro
macro.desc: A petal, a strand, a single drop. The world at the scale of almost-not-there.

event.title: Events
event.desc: Weddings, birthdays, small parties, big nights. I stay close, I don't intrude, and I leave with the moments you would have missed.

wildlife.title: Animals
wildlife.desc: Patient, slow, on their terms. A lot of waiting, a little luck.

01.title: We plan together
01.body: Every session starts with a conversation. We’ll discuss your vision, preferred style and location through messages, a phone call or a video chat, whatever feels easiest for you.
bullets: We’ll choose the perfect location together
We’ll define the style and mood
Messages, phone or video consultation available

02.title: I prepare everything
02.body: I’ll create a personalized shooting plan based on your ideas. I’ll also review your outfits, offer styling advice and, especially for street photography, prepare poses and prompts that suit you naturally.
bullets: Natural posing guidance prepared in advance

03.title: We shoot
03.body: On the day of your session, there’s no pressure to perform. I’ll guide you naturally while keeping the atmosphere relaxed, comfortable and fun.

04.title: I craft every image
04.body: Every final photograph is carefully edited by hand. My cinematic color grading is an essential part of my style, giving your images a timeless, emotional look while staying true to the moment.

pricing.title: A few ways to work together.
pricing.description: Every shoot is a little different, so I'd rather hear what you have in mind than sell you a package. These are starting points — write to me and I'll send you a tailored quote.

basic.blurb: A face, a couple, a quiet afternoon.

cody.name: Cody Fisher
cody.quote: I'm still a little in awe of how the photos turned out. Lili has a way of making you forget the camera is even there.

savannah.name: Savannah Nguyen
savannah.quote: From the first message, everything felt easy. Lili listened, suggested spots I would never have found, and the shoot itself felt like a walk with a friend.

wade.name: Wade Warren
wade.quote: Booked Lili for our grad portraits and I'm so glad I did. She quietly directed the whole thing, and we ended up with photos that feel very us.

floyd.name: Floyd Miles
floyd.quote: Lili made our maternity shoot feel so special. The photos are quiet and tender — exactly what we hoped for.

jenny.name: Jenny Wilson
jenny.quote: I needed someone who could move quickly without losing the look I had in mind. Lili was that — and the photos landed on the first round.
